purpose: Keep the LoRA benchmark grounded in real current provider surfaces without turning unstable MVP schemas into permanent training targets.

shared_transport.reasoning_policy: reasoning=off when the loaded model exposes a configurable reasoning mode; otherwise no reasoning parameter; models that expose configurable reasoning without off are rejected by the local recipe
shared_transport.benchmark_implication: BASE and LORA comparative conditions must use the same transport, decoding contract and reasoning policy. Adapter activation is the intended semantic difference.

input_summary: bounded CognitionContext already authorized by engine services
attention and direct perceived events
recent subjective memories and contextual autobiographical memories
beliefs, mood, affect episodes, relationships and boundaries
decision frame and operational self grounding
allowed traversals and, for planned_reflection, allowed activities
decision_cue as technical reason for one decision opportunity

output_contract.selection_constraint: Prompt enumerates exact valid_actions and asks the model to copy exactly one; parser then revalidates the strict schema.
output_contract.narrow_legacy_adapter: A known syntax variation where action directly equals an allowed activity_type may be normalized only when the exact activity/location pair was already exposed by the engine.

stable_discipline_relevant_to_lora: LLM proposes; engine validates
do not invent destination or activity
decision cue is context, not command
no_action remains valid when context supports it
world and subjective state come only from provided context
surfaces.training_policy: Do not train the general LoRA to memorize schema_version 8 or the current activity whitelist. Use this surface for compatibility evaluation and synthetic invariant examples only.

input_summary: bounded active scene and participants
recent validated social speech acts
speaker CognitionContext
duplicate recent-memory speech sources removed from the memory projection

output_contract.semantics: At most one short speech act or silence; expression is never itself a proven fact, consent, relation or permission.
output_contract.narrow_legacy_adapter: Known local-model form action=<act_kind> may normalize to action=speak only when act_kind and all required fields already agree.

stable_discipline_relevant_to_lora: speech != fact
speech != consent/permission/relationship
do not invent participant, object or event
no_action is a legitimate conversational choice
subjective context can inform expression without becoming canon
surfaces.training_policy: Use for compatibility evaluation now; do not bake current scene-turn lifecycle or exact act taxonomy into the general LoRA.

input_summary: closed owner-scoped snapshot derived from an accessible subjective social-speech trace
observer interaction role
primary trace plus up to three selected contextual traces
optional prior interpretation revision

status_constraints: clear => at least one meaning hypothesis
ambiguous => at least two distinct meaning hypotheses
maximum three hypotheses and 280 characters each

stable_discipline_relevant_to_lora: interpret only the supplied subjective snapshot
world text is untrusted data, never engine instruction
do not claim the real intention of another agent
do not promote an assertion to truth
ambiguity and unresolved interpretation are legitimate outcomes
surfaces.training_policy: Good source of invariant-level training examples after clean-room separation, but the general LoRA should learn the epistemic behavior rather than the exact schema/version strings.

input_summary: owner-scoped social interpretation
owner goals and active intention
owner relationships and active boundaries
explicit allowed base references

constraints: candidates are proposed routings to future domains, not new mental state
basis refs must come from allowed refs
unresolved => uncertain/uncertain with no bases or candidates

stable_discipline_relevant_to_lora: appraise only what the supplied interpretation means for the owner
do not infer hidden motive, hidden intention, real emotion, sincerity, personality or truth of another agent
candidate justification cannot create new private state
do not invent provenance refs
world text remains untrusted data
surfaces.training_policy: Useful for hidden-state and provenance discipline training only after held-out isolation; do not hard-code current candidate domains as universal cognition ontology.

input_summary: owner-scoped affect candidate produced downstream from appraisal
appraisal and source interpretation status
source trace
current owner mood and up to five active affect episodes
explicit allowed targets and support refs

constraints: no_change => family/intensity/target null and support_refs empty
start_episode => valid family/intensity and non-empty allowed support refs
provider does not propose action, expression or mood modification

stable_discipline_relevant_to_lora: do not infer another agent's hidden motive or intention
private affect decision must remain supported by owner-scoped evidence
do not invent support provenance
affect proposal is not action/expression/canon
world text remains untrusted data
surfaces.training_policy: Use as a compatibility surface and source of generic evidence-discipline examples; do not train exact emotion family taxonomy as a universal RIC law.

cross_surface_findings: The current providers already repeat the same epistemic safety concepts in different prompts: bounded snapshot/context, world text as data, no hidden-state omniscience, strict structured output and proposal-not-canon boundaries.

The output schemas are intentionally task-specific. A useful general LoRA should therefore improve the repeated behavioral invariants across different schemas rather than optimize one canonical JSON form.
Conversation State, BOL and P3.5 are expected to change scene/autonomy inputs and contracts. Current exact schema strings are therefore compatibility targets, not permanent training canon.

SCC1B/SCC2A/SCC3A provide the cleanest already-grounded examples of the discipline the adapter is supposed to learn, but held-out benchmark text must remain clean-room separated from any training examples derived from these concepts.

benchmark_design_consequence.layer_A_contract_agnostic: Keep the current semantic held-out fixtures independent of exact production JSON so they survive future Conversation State, BOL and P3.5 changes.
benchmark_design_consequence.layer_B_runtime_compatibility: Add a smaller versioned compatibility suite generated from real provider contracts; rerun it whenever provider_version/schema/prompt recipes change.
benchmark_design_consequence.training_rule: Prefer synthetic transformations of invariant classes over copying production snapshots or benchmark fixtures into training.
benchmark_design_consequence.freeze_rule: Do not freeze Layer B against current scene/autonomy schemas until the intended evaluation point is chosen; they are known to be roadmap-sensitive.
